summary: Otero Co., NM tower listed standing with coordinates; Forest Lookouts page gives only a location heading; no build, owner or access record found.

evidence.supports: listed as a standing tower in Otero County, with coordinates and no register number
the page's location heading for the tower is the Mescalero Indian Agency line; the page gives no county or owner

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The brief's https://westlookouts.weebly.com/cienegita.html returns 404 on our fetch; the same page is served at the http:// form, which the story cites. The brief's source link should be corrected. The page's location heading is 'New Mexico - Mescalero Indian Agency'; no county or owner appears on the page, and the story does not infer ownership from it, and the owner or manager should be confirmed before any visit. Name searches returned a June 2022 Cienegita Fire near Ruidoso on the Mescalero Apache reservation (inciweb updates). Those pages were not read and no source ties the fire to the tower, so the story does not mention the fire. An editor may want a note on the name collision. No build, builder, height, staffing or access record was found.
